title: Remove unsupported legacy compatibility from unreleased TermAl
outcome: TermAl is still in development and has no production history that requires compatibility with previous local builds. Remove migrations, alternate schemas, loose wire shapes, old localStorage layouts, old TermAl-to-TermAl protocol branches, and hypothetical compatibility code. Local developer state may be reset or rejected instead of migrated. Preserve only current runtime recovery, temporal stale-response protection, current filesystem/input handling, and external compatibility explicitly required by one pinned supported upstream version.
acceptance: Every child area uses one documented current schema and protocol; no production path exists solely for data or API shapes from previous TermAl development builds; tests construct only current fixtures except explicit rejection tests; docs stop promising migration of unreleased state; a final audit classifies every remaining legacy/compatibility occurrence as current external/platform behavior or removes it.
